description: This file defines the RScatter class for rendering scatter plots using the RGraph library. It includes methods for drawing the background, plotting data points, handling tooltips, and configuring chart properties.

classes.name: RGraph.RScatter
classes.description: Class for rendering scatter plot charts with interactive features, tooltips, and customizable properties.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a property value; supports configuration via object or key-value pair.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a property.

methods.name: Draw
methods.description: Main method to draw the scatter chart, including background, data points, labels, and title.

methods.name: DrawBackground
methods.description: Draws the chart background, grid lines, axes, and caps.

methods.name: DrawRscatter
methods.description: Plots the data points on the scatter chart.

methods.name: DrawLabels
methods.description: Draws labels, axes, and key on the chart.

methods.name: DrawCircularLabels
methods.description: Draws labels around the circular chart.

methods.name: DrawTick
methods.description: Draws a tick mark at a specified position.

methods.name: getShape
methods.description: Returns shape info if hovered over a data point.

methods.name: getPoint
methods.description: Alias for getShape, retrieves point info based on event.

methods.name: allowTooltips
methods.description: Enables tooltip functionality.

methods.name: highlight
methods.description: Highlights a shape or data point.

methods.name: getObjectByXY
methods.description: Returns the chart object if the event is over the chart area.

methods.name: positionTooltip
methods.description: Positions the tooltip element near the data point.

methods.name: getRadius
methods.description: Calculates radius for a given data value.

methods.name: parseColors
methods.description: Parses color strings for gradients.

methods.name: parseSingleColorForGradient
methods.description: Converts a color string to a gradient object if specified.

methods.name: interactiveKeyHighlight
methods.description: Highlights an entire data series in the key.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Adds an event listener to the chart object.

methods.name: resetColorsToOriginalValues
methods.description: Resets colors to their original values.

methods.name: firstDrawFunc
methods.description: Function called after the first draw.
